summary:
Anthony Sousa is a Canadian Liberal politician and the Member of Parliament for Mississauga–Lakeshore. He entered Ontario’s legislature in 2007 and served as the province’s Minister of Finance from 2013 to 2018, after holding other cabinet roles. As finance minister, he helped secure an agreement to enhance the Canada Pension Plan and presented Ontario’s first balanced budget since the 2008 recession. He lost his provincial seat in 2018.

Sousa won the Mississauga–Lakeshore federal by-election on December 12, 2022, and was re-elected in 2025. In September 2023, he became Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Public Services and Procurement. In the 45th Parliament, he was elected chair of the House of Commons Standing Committee on National Defence.
